title: Billing and Coding: Luteinizing Hormone-Releasing Hormone (LHRH) Analogs

codes.1: Effective for dates of service on or after 01/01/2023, leuprolide acetate for depot suspension (Lutrate) should be reported with HCPCS code J1954. Effective for dates of service on or after 01/01/2022, leuprolide mesylate (Camcevi®), should be reported with HCPCS code J1952. Effective for dates of service 5/26/2021 through 12/31/2021, leuprolide mesylate (Camcevi®), should be reported with HCPCS code J3590. CPT Code J9218 is not covered under Medicare because it is self-administered.
